svg.title: Throughput by workload
svg.desc: and: sift 13,381, sift (positions off) 13,710, Elasticsearch 5,138, pg_search 2,341, pg_textsearch 73, rum 2,608, pgx-bm25 93; or: sift 4,004, sift (positions off) 3,918, Elasticsearch 2,768, pg_search 1,700, pg_textsearch 4,206, rum 23, pgx-bm25 74; phrase: sift 11,724, sift (positions off) 2,794, Elasticsearch 8,454, pg_search 2,281, pg_textsearch 89, rum 73, pgx-bm25 54; mixed: sift 7,377, sift (positions off) 4,846, Elasticsearch 5,880, pg_search 2,051, pg_textsearch 100, rum 51, pgx-bm25 57; count(*): sift 14,375, sift (positions off) 3,451, Elasticsearch 8,877, pg_search 2,286, pg_textsearch 131, rum 101, pgx-bm25 56; filter: sift 6,048, sift (positions off) 5,203, Elasticsearch 5,416, pg_search 1,988, pg_textsearch 79, rum 49, pgx-bm25 61; join: sift 3,101, sift (positions off) 2,019, Elasticsearch 5,613, pg_search 430, pg_textsearch 97, rum 47, pgx-bm25 62
svg.text: queries per second, higher is better
Error bars: one standard error over the interleaved rounds (rough for 2-3); red: relative error above 10%.
Elasticsearch: a JVM server over HTTP; its join is a term filter on a denormalized region field.
Simple English Wikipedia, 50,000 articles, 8 clients, median of 2-3 rounds; AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads (load avg 8-14); Oct 2026.
